name: Discrete Choice Methods for Travel Demand Analysis
description: Introduction to discrete choice modelling – model specification; Review of model estimation concepts; Random utility maximization and Logit Models; Models for Binary and Multinomial Choice; Nested Logit model; Concepts of heterogeneity and Mixed Multinomial Logit Model; Integrated choice and latent variable model; Models for ordered data; Experimental design for choice modelling; Model estimation by pooling data; Machine learning integrated discrete choice models; Applications of choice models to transportation engineering problems.
